channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 21
item.description:
57 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Added a ridable horse prefab, allowing players to mount and ride horses.
  • Added fuseboxes to every monument that contains them, enabling players to interact with fuseboxes across the map.
  • Fixed upgraded external gate doors losing their controller settings, preserving door controller behavior after upgrades.
  • Deployables no longer become hidden when an exterior door closes, fixing clipping‑through‑door visual bugs.

Transportation

  • Added a ridable horse prefab, allowing players to mount and ride horses.
  • Fixed the boat power‑down mechanic so lowering sails and quickly jumping off no longer leaves the boat drifting.
  • Repaired broken helipad stages, restoring proper functionality of the repairable helipad pad.

World Objects & Rendering

  • Added fuseboxes to every monument that contains them, enabling players to interact with fuseboxes across the map.
  • Improved terrain deformation handling for building: deployables now respect a configurable tolerance and foundations are placed against the original terrain height, preventing placement issues on deformed terrain.
  • Fixed a hierarchical LOD issue where distant structures could disappear, ensuring buildings and other structures are visible at long range.

Base Building & Upgrades

  • Fixed upgraded external gate doors losing their controller settings, preserving door controller behavior after upgrades.
  • Deployables no longer become hidden when an exterior door closes, fixing clipping‑through‑door visual bugs.
  • Added a 15‑minute delay to the oil rig pump mechanic (total cycle 20 min + 15 min delay), changing oil production timing.

Loadout & Inventory

  • Loadout items now retain correct default position when loading older JSON files; the system now uses MoveToContainer to place items, fixing mis‑positioned gear.

Animals & AI

  • Squirrel movement speed adjusted, changing how quickly squirrels traverse the map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Fixed a crash when rapidly opening the in‑game store; URLs now correctly use cache, preventing errors on quick tab switches.
  • Resolved UI issue where the computer station identifier input box text could disappear at certain screen resolutions.

Combat & Animation

  • Sprint animation now correctly stops when a networked attack occurs, ensuring consistent sprint behavior across players.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 20
item.description:
17 development commits

Base Building

  • Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

Livestock & Animals

  • Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Item Durability

  • Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 19
item.description:
16 development commits

Livestock & Animal Behavior

  • Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
  • Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
  • Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
  • Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
  • Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

UI & Store

  • Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.
